description: MTT results imported from tournament summary files. Money is in cents. Hand histories are not a source of buy-ins or prizes. If this account has no hands, offer the hosted upload page from get_upload_link (https://pokerdata.io/upload) instead of asking the user to paste histories into chat.
name: get_tournament_results

outputSchema.description: MTT results from uploaded tournament summaries. Money is in cents.

buyInCents.description: Total buy-ins, or null when one buy-in is unknown.

itmPct.description: Share of tournaments that cashed, 0 to 1, or null.

netProfitCents.description: Received minus buy-ins, or null when a buy-in is unknown.

note.description: Present when no tournament summaries have been uploaded.

sourceId.description: Tournament id from the summary file.

roi.description: Return on investment as a ratio, or null.

title: Get my tournament results
